subject: SIG/CAIQ + ISO/FedRAMP intake & evidence roadmap
messages:
From: Timothy Lewis <timothy.lewis@acme.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Initial intake: SIG/CAIQ + ISO/FedRAMP artifact request

Hi Olga,

Thanks for agreeing to help — Acme's security team is doing a pre-procurement compliance review and we need a short intake so we can scope an upcoming SIG/CAIQ and an ISO/FedRAMP-readiness checkpoint. Attached is a worksheet with our initial SIG mappings; please confirm owners for the rows that say "vendor to confirm".

High-level asks:
- Can you confirm the ISO 27001 scope summary for Redwood and any controls currently outside scope? (we need this to assess gap exposure)
- Do you have a current SIG/CAIQ someone can own and return within two weeks?
- Any current FedRAMP-related artifacts or punchlist items we should be aware of (since Acme is in the financial vertical, we may require evidence on logging, encryption in transit, and key management)

Proposed timeline: intake this week -> evidence kickoff next Tue/Wed -> deliver completed SIG in ~10 business days. Is that feasible?

Attachments: acme_sig_questions_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Timothy Lewis
Senior Security Engineer
Acme Bank — Vendor Risk Team

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Timothy Lewis <timothy.lewis@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, security@acme.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 12:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Initial intake: SIG/CAIQ + ISO/FedRAMP artifact request

Hi Timothy — thanks for the worksheet and the clear asks. 

Quick responses:
- ISO scope: Redwood's ISO 27001 scope covers the hosted Redwood API and control plane for hosted customers; our Private deployment package (VPC & on-prem) is documented separately and several operational controls (physical data center controls for on-prem) are out-of-scope for the hosted cert. I will attach the scope summary and call out the top 3 control exceptions.
- SIG/CAIQ: Mina is the owner for SIG intake and will coordinate the CAIQ response.
- FedRAMP artifacts: we don't currently hold a FedRAMP authorization, but we maintain a FedRAMP-readiness folder with evidentiary artifacts we share for pre-audit review (logging architecture, KMS integration diagrams, mulit-tenant isolation notes).

I want to loop in Marcus and Mina to map evidence owners and propose a delivery plan. Proposed next step: Mina runs the SIG against your attached spreadsheet, flags items with long lead times (3+ weeks), and we schedule a 30-minute kickoff with your team next Tue 2027-04-27 10:00am ET if that works.

Olga
Olga Petrov
Head of Compliance & Trust Operations
Redwood Inference

Forwarding Acme's intake. Mina — can you pick this up as owner and triage the attached spreadsheet? Please produce:

1) An owned SIG/CAIQ draft with a status column (Owned / Vendor confirmation needed / Third-party evidence)
2) A short list of 5 controls likely to need > 10 business days and a recommended mitigation (e.g., temporary attestations, architecture diagrams)
3) A proposed evidence collection spreadsheet with a named owner for each row

Vivek — once Mina identifies controls that require engineering changes (e.g., log retention config or KMS integration updates) can you estimate ETA and whether we can provide a compensating control in the meantime?

Goal: have the SIG draft and evidence-owner mapping by EOD Monday 2027-04-26 so we can review before the kickoff with Acme on Tue.

Thanks,
Marcus

Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Fwd: Initial intake: SIG/CAIQ + ISO/FedRAMP artifact request

I've triaged Acme's spreadsheet and started a draft CAIQ. Highlights:

- ~70% of the rows can be answered with existing artifacts we maintain (policies, diagrams, SOC 2 excerpts).
- 6 items are marked as "engineering action" (primarily: extended log retention config, SME access review runbook, and tenant isolation verification). Estimated work: 7-15 business days depending on engineering bandwidth.
- 3 items will require a 3rd-party attestation or a vendor letter (SaaS subprocessors) which typically adds ~10 business days to obtain.

I've uploaded an evidence intake template and populated owner candidates. Link and attachments below. I can produce the CAIQ draft by EOD Monday if Marcus can review for accuracy.

Attachments: evidence_inventory_template.csv, redwood_iso_scope_summary.pdf
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-compliance-intake
HubSpot: HS-456712 (ticket created)

Next steps I propose:
- Marcus: review CAIQ draft and mark any control statements that need legal or product review.
- Vivek: quick check on the 6 engineering items to confirm ETA and whether a compensating control (diagram + compensating attestation) is acceptable for the next 2 weeks.
- Olga: confirm kickoff time to coordinate with Acme.

Mina
Senior Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
